scope: Cast-exclusive and Great Ape skill taxonomy corrections

corrections.name: Gigantic Slam
corrections.character_source: Broly; Broly (Supervillain); Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan) Customize Partner
corrections.reason: Dedicated Xenoverse 2 skill page explicitly identifies Gigantic Slam as a Strike Super, 100 Ki, and unavailable to CaCs.

corrections.name: Boulder Break
corrections.character_source: Great Ape Nappa; Great Ape Bardock
corrections.reason: Current sources establish Boulder Break as a Super Skill used by Great Apes; its physical boulder-slam behavior supports Strike taxonomy. Cost remains unresolved.

corrections.name: Boulder Toss
corrections.character_source: Great Ape Nappa; Great Ape Vegeta
corrections.reason: Current sources establish Boulder Toss as the physical rock-throw Super Skill used by Great Apes; cost remains unresolved.

corrections.name: Energy Cannon
corrections.reason: Retain Ki Blast classification and cast-only status; no reliable numeric Ki-cost evidence was found.

corrections.name: Beam Rifle
corrections.reason: Retain Ki Blast classification and cast-only status; no reliable numeric Ki-cost evidence was found.

notes: Giant Storm was not added to the Super catalog because current sources identify it as an Ultimate Skill. Poison was not added because current evidence states the Poison skill does not return in Xenoverse 2. Saibabeam and Acid remain candidates pending dedicated XV2 subtype/cost evidence.
